name: cycle_1C_discharge_charge
description: One cycle: 1C constant-current discharge, rest, 1C CC-CV charge, rest
comment: 1C = 1.900 A for LP604765, which is also its standard_charge_a and standard_discharge_a, so both directions run at the cell's rated normal rate. Discharge stops at 2.80 V (above the 2.75 V floor), rests 10 min, then CC-CV charges to 4.20 V ending at a 0.05C = 0.095 A taper, then rests 10 min. PRECONDITION: start from a full cell, otherwise the discharge capacity is not a capacity. max_duration_s applies per phase. Override the cell at launch with --cell; raise repeat for more cycles.
